title: Compile budget: serve A2A in-tree without the ra2a SDK
goal: CEO: bring Susi core under 30 s. ra2a 0.10.1 (through susi-vendor-ra2a) is the only path from the susi build to reqwest, hyper-tls, encoding_rs, chrono, tower-http, uuid, futures and thiserror. Serve the subset of A2A the daemon serves (agent card, JSON-RPC message send, SSE streaming, tasks get/list/cancel/resubscribe, push-notification configs and delivery, the 1.0 method names and the slash aliases, the error codes) from crates/susi-gawd-a2a/src/protocol on the axum/tokio/hyper stack already in core, with push delivery over susi-http-transport and the bounded task retention unchanged. A transcript of 79 real HTTP exchanges recorded from the ra2a stack before it left is the wire golden the in-tree protocol must reproduce. susi-vendor-ra2a is deleted; ceilings and the wave log record the before/after numbers.
